Check if job IDs are currently in the job queue

Source: R/jobs.R
job_in_sq.Rd

Queries the job queue using the sq command to determine if one or more job IDs are currently active (running or queued).

Usage

job_in_sq(job_id)

Arguments

job_id

Numeric or character vector. Job IDs to check in the queue.

Value

Logical vector. Returns TRUE for job IDs found in the queue, FALSE for job IDs not found or if the sq command fails.

Details

This function executes the sq command to retrieve current job queue information and parses the output to check for the presence of specified job IDs. The function:

  1. Runs system2("sq") to get queue status

  2. Parses the output as a space-separated table with headers

  3. Checks if job IDs exist in the JOBID column

If the sq command fails or its output has no JOBID column, the function returns FALSE with a warning. A header-only listing is an empty queue.

See also

monitor_jobs for monitoring job completion, execute_job for submitting jobs

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Check single job ID
job_in_sq(12345)

# Check multiple job IDs
job_in_sq(c(12345, 67890))

job_in_sq(c("12345", "67890"))
} # }
